value.rationale: Two Rademacher-probe trace estimation with graph-aware coupling is a natural variance-reduction design problem. Weighted C5 is the smallest simple-cycle example where fixed sign-flip couplings leave avoidable variance despite preserving correct independent marginal signs; the complete t-phase diagram and maximal 25% reduction are exact and have a concrete design interpretation. This is a finite benchmark, not a claim of an improved general-purpose trace algorithm.
